To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
aspect oriented programming is a powerful technique in composing multiple abstraction models on one another.
the aspect oriented re-factored implementation of middleware platform is more configurable and more adaptable than its legacy counterpart.

the aspect oriented re-factorizations of the quantified aspects are able to reduce both the structural complexity of the legacy implementations and the runtime performance overhead of the aspectized implementations, and that the aspect oriented approach is a promising way to achieve a higher level of configurability for the middleware platforms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a systematic approach to the identification and re-factoring of aspects from the legacy code of a middleware system.
the application of the aspect oriented programming in middleware technologies.
the application of aspect oriented programming to middleware architecture, and the quantification of the changes of the aspectized system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the aspect oriented re-factored architecture is a better design than the legacy one.
the aspect oriented re-factoring has greatly improved the modularity, configurability and maintainability of a middleware architecture.
aspect oriented programming has the potential to be a powerful tool to re-factor and re-engineer legacy middleware systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the aspect oriented re-factorizations are able to improve the design modularity and the system performance, and also increase the system configurability.
, the quantification of design concerns in middleware systems and the re-factoring based on the identified concerns can be very useful for the improvement of middleware architectures.
the aspect oriented approach is able to provide a better solution in terms of modularity and configurability for middleware platforms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the quantification of design concerns in legacy implementations is a very important step towards the successful adoption of aspect oriented programming.

, the aspect oriented approach is a powerful technique for improving software quality, and the aspect oriented re-factored code can provide a better basis for the future development of the middleware system.
aspect oriented programming provides an excellent mechanism for re-factoring legacy systems, especially those with a large number of crosscutting concerns.
